title: Key Discovery And Camelot Evaluation

decisionGates.description: After candidate key detector install smoke tests, report which backends are genuinely runnable before benchmarking.
After benchmarking candidate detectors against Rekordbox Tonality truth, stop for user review before selecting the default detector or ensemble.
After generating the first transition candidate report using AutoDJ-detected keys, ask whether the scoring feels musically useful before enabling strict key rejections.

subagentExecutionRules: Read this kiro.json, requirements.md, design.md, tasks.md, and all required steering context before executing tasks.
Treat Rekordbox XML Tonality as benchmark ground truth only, not the production key source.
Do not leave candidate key detectors as graceful-failure placeholders; install and smoke-test each selected candidate before benchmarking it.
Keep key detectors modular so candidate backends and future native implementations can be swapped.
Record processing time and install/runtime constraints for every candidate.
Do not add pitch shifting, key sync, or time-stretch behavior in this spec.
Do not commit local Rekordbox XML exports, real songs, rendered mixes, model downloads, or generated cache artifacts.
Stop at manual decision gates and record the user's verdict before marking those tasks complete.
